description: Accumulator: every clock adds a fixed amount to a stored voltage, and a trigger fires when that voltage crosses a threshold

params.text: The amount added to the stored voltage on each clock, -1V to 1V
The voltage the accumulator is set to on a reset, -10V to 10V
Sets the stored voltage to the Set value
The voltage the stored value has to cross for a trigger to fire, -10V to 10V

inputs.text: Each rising edge adds the step amount to the stored voltage, and the number of channels patched here sets how many accumulators run side by side
A trigger sets the stored voltage to the Set value and blocks the clock for 1ms
Sets the step amount, 10V here giving a step of 1V, and overrides the Step knob while patched
Sets the value the accumulator resets to and overrides the Set knob while patched
Sets the threshold and overrides the Trsh knob while patched

outputs.text: The stored voltage, with one channel per channel of the clock input
A 1ms trigger when the stored voltage crosses the threshold, on that accumulator's channel; patching it back into Rst makes the accumulator loop
